seoTitle: JPG, PNG and WebP Image Converter
metaDescription: Convert JPG, PNG and WebP images directly in your browser.
intro: Convert JPG, PNG and WebP images directly in your browser.
aboutTitle: Which image format should I choose?
about: PNG preserves transparency when the source has it. WebP is useful when your publishing workflow supports it. JPG is an option for photos and uses a white background when the input is transparent.
example: Upload a transparent PNG and select WebP if your site accepts it. Check the preview and download the converted file.

faqs.question: Can this tool convert SVG or animated GIF files?
faqs.answer: This converter accepts JPG, PNG and WebP image inputs. Use a separate workflow for SVG or animation.
